description: Two rectangular chambers (~180m x 230m each) connected by a narrow 40m-wide passage, representative of a survey region split by a natural obstacle (e.g., a canal, road, or forested strip) with a single crossing point

wind.description: Wind at 30° (NNE, 2 m/s, wind ratio 0.167); deliberately misaligned with the axis-aligned corridor chambers, forcing the proposed method to use 30°-tilted strips that must navigate the narrow passage diagonally

cell.description: 20m x 20m sensing cell; corridor width (40m) accommodates exactly 2 cells across
